blocks.title: Greedy algorithm
blocks.text: Greedy algorithm intikhabaat ka silsila karta hai, har ek us waqt ka behtareen (locally optimal), is umeed par ke yeh mukammal behtareen hal tak le jayein. Yeh optimal substructure wale masail ke liye munasib hai.

Coin change: kam se kam sikkon mein raqam banane ke liye baar baar woh sab se bara sikka lein jo baqi raqam se zyada na ho aur use ghata dein. 1, 2, 5 aur 10 ke sikkon se 18 = 10 + 5 + 2 + 1, chaar sikke. Greedy algorithms doosri techniques se tez aur banane mein aasan hain, magar hamesha behtareen jawab nahi dete, to jaanch lein ke greedy tareeqa masle par theek baithta hai (Tip).

blocks.prompt: 1, 3 aur 4 ke sikkon se greedy tareeqa 6 ke liye kya deta hai, aur behtareen jawab kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Greedy 4 + 1 + 1, teen sikke leta hai, magar 3 + 3 sirf do istemal karta hai, to yahan greedy behtareen nahi.

blocks.prompt: Greedy algorithms ka bunyadi khayal bataiye (short question 4).
blocks.explanation: Har qadam par woh intikhab lein jo abhi behtareen lage aur us par wapas na jayein, is umeed par ke maqami behtareen intikhab mil kar mukammal behtareen hal dein; yeh tez hai magar sirf munasib banawat wale masail par poori tarah chalta hai.

items: Greedy: abhi ka behtareen intikhab, wapsi nahi; coin change 18 = 10 + 5 + 2 + 1; hamesha behtareen nahi (1, 3, 4 se 6).
